decisions.title: Architecture uses hybrid authority
decisions.summary: Implementation facts establish what exists; authored assertions establish intended structure; views remain projections.

decisions.title: Shell remains required infrastructure
decisions.summary: Shell owns the browser bootstrap, navigation, and mounts; packages do not replace it.

decisions.title: Use the package contract as Resonance's extension seam
decisions.summary: Team and member packages use one manifest-selected contract that composes routes, assets, navigation, browser entries, and package-owned lifecycle behavior.

decisions.title: Keep browser composition in Shell and workspace state in packages
decisions.summary: Shell owns the document and lifecycle while package browser entries own their workspace state behind a small mount, activation, and deactivation interface.
